detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Play as The Krasue, a gruesome Killer with two terrifying forms, or Vee Boonyasak, an electrifying survivor from the rising punk band Axekick. Experience a terrifying take on Thai Folklore rooted in visceral Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace.

 

Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace

An opera singer consumed by a gruesome curse. A young drummer seeking to make it big. Dead by Daylight: Sinister Grace is an original Chapter featuring a new Killer, The Krasue, and a new Survivor, Vee Boonyasak.

 

The Krasue

By day, Burong Sukapat was a beautiful and talented performer. By night, The Krasue's curse awakened, plunging her into a nightmare of torn flesh, sopping blood, and insatiable hunger.

POWER: UNBODIED FLESH

Track, transform, and terrorize your prey with two distinct and deadly forms.

Violently spring from your body and hunt as a floating head, using a vile Intestinal Whip to strike with a vicious attack. Your speed is increased during this form, allowing you to traverse the Map and slaughter your prey with deadly efficacy.

Hunt on foot, regurgitate a projectile at Survivors and infect them with the Leeching Gland. Infected Survivors are far more vulnerable to Intestinal whip attacks, leaving you in a prime position to switch forms and inflict true misery upon them.

The Krasue’s Perks

 

Hex: Overture of Doom:  Curse a Generator to mislead Survivors with a false Terror Radius, allowing you to approach them undetected and catch them off guard.

 

Ravenous: After every Survivor has been Hooked once, they will scream and temporarily become Exposed.

Wandering Eye: While chasing a Survivor, the Aura of all nearby injured Survivors will be briefly revealed.

Vee Boonyasak

The beating heart of Axekick, drummer Vee Boonyasak's infectious attitude, up-tempo pace, and kinetic energy bring a new dynamic to every Trial.


Vee Boonyasak’s Perks

Ghost Notes allows you to recover from Exhaustion faster. Not only that, your Scratch Marks will disappear quicker too.

Use ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! to kick off a performance that will invigorate your teammates, empowering them with a slew of Skill Checks.

With Road Life, complete Repair Great Skill Checks while injured to earn Tokens, which can be spent to heal a Health State.

 

Exclusive Chapter Cosmetics

The Sinister Grace Chapter includes an exclusive Cosmetic for both characters: The Krasue’s Relaxed Reds, and Vee Boonyasak’s Camo Cami.  These are only available as part of the DLC, and cannot be purchased separately.
